answer: One concrete mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. The required words slot into it cleanly: atlas maps onto the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work, anchor tracks the way a public ledger splits one identity's activity into separable, linkable facets, and river embodies the stake an honest agent locks before speaking. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture.
